description:
AgileEngine is an Inc. 5000 company that creates award-winning software for Fortune 500 brands and trailblazing startups across 17+ industries. We rank among the leaders in areas like application development and AI/ML, and our people-first culture has earned us multiple Best Place to Work awards.

WHY JOIN US
If you're looking for a place to grow, make an impact, and work with people who care, we'd love to meet you!

ABOUT THE ROLE
We are looking for a Flutter Developer to take technical ownership of a new iOS product from the ground up. This person drives greenfield development independently, turning product needs into engineering decisions while building familiarity with iOS and low-level technology as needed. Comfort supervising AI-assisted development and verifying implementation quality is essential.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Take technical ownership of a new product for iOS.
- Drive greenfield implementation, turning product needs into manageable engineering tasks and technical decisions.
- Develop the product using Flutter and build understanding of the surrounding iOS and low-level technology context as needed.
- Resolve unfamiliar technical problems through investigation, collaboration, and supervised use of AI tools.
- Use Claude Code in daily development while retaining responsibility for the correctness and quality of delivered implementations.
- Contribute to adjacent engineering tasks, including build and delivery workflows, when required.

MUST HAVES
- Strong hands-on Flutter engineering skills, with at least 3 years of experience.
- Ability to lead greenfield product development and take technical ownership as the single engineer allocated to the product.
- Critical thinking: break complex problems into clear steps, identify unknowns, and ask useful questions of teammates and AI agents.
- Ability to supervise AI-assisted development, review generated code, and verify that implementations achieve the intended result.
- Willingness to learn and contribute outside the primary stack, including C++ packages, front-end tasks, and CI/CD, when product needs require it.
- Upper-intermediate English level.

NICE TO HAVES
- High-level understanding of LLVM, Swift, and C++.
- Familiarity with iOS development and the associated build ecosystem.
- Experience with application hardening, code obfuscation, runtime protection, or developer tooling.

PERKS AND BENEFITS
- Professional growth: Accelerate your professional journey with mentorship, TechTalks, and personalized growth roadmaps.
- Competitive compensation: We match your ever-growing skills, talent, and contributions with competitive USD-based compensation and budgets for education, fitness, and team activities.
- A selection of exciting projects: Join projects with modern solutions development and top-tier clients that include Fortune 500 enterprises and leading product brands.
- Flextime: Tailor your schedule for an optimal work-life balance, by having the options of working from home and going to the office – whatever makes you the happiest and most productive.

Meet Our Recruitment Process
Application → Coding Challenge → Video Interview → Technical Interview or Hiring Manager Interview
Each step helps us understand your skills and overall fit.
If it’s a match, you’ll receive an offer.
